headline: Inflation worsened last month to 3.7% in sign that prices remain elevated as midterm elections near - myMotherLode.com
summary: US consumer price inflation accelerated in September as gasoline, clothing and airfares rose, the Labor Department said. The reading underlines price pressure just weeks before the midterm elections.
why: The consumer price index tracks the cost of a basket of goods and services and heavily influences Federal Reserve interest-rate decisions, which affect bond yields and equity valuations.

why_moved: The reading was higher than the prior month's 3.4%, and the report cited gasoline and other prices rising. Stronger inflation tends to push up expectations for tighter monetary policy.
